title: DevOps Roadmap Learning Tree
description: A roadmap-based DevOps learning tree using branching progression, node-type variety, and KSA scoring.
subject: DevOps

chapters.title: Foundations
chapters.description: Core operating system, networking, scripting, programming, and version control skills.

chapters.title: Containers and Platform
chapters.description: Containerization, orchestration, and production platform basics.

chapters.title: Delivery and Automation
chapters.description: CI/CD, GitOps, infrastructure provisioning, and configuration automation.

chapters.title: Operations and Reliability
chapters.description: Monitoring, logging, tracing, secrets, and operational troubleshooting.

chapters.title: Advanced Architecture
chapters.description: Advanced runtime patterns, service mesh, serverless, and integrative delivery challenges.

branches.title: Alternative Route
branches.description: Equivalent alternatives where the roadmap suggests choosing one of several tools.

nodes.title: Linux Fundamentals
nodes.description: Filesystem, processes, packages, services, permissions, users, shell basics, and day-to-day Linux administration.

nodes.title: Linux CLI Practice
nodes.description: Hands-on command line work: processes, logs, services, permissions, archives, SSH, and package operations.

nodes.title: Networking and Protocols
nodes.description: HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TCP/IP, SSH, TLS, SMTP, IMAP, ports, firewalls, proxies, load balancers, and the OSI model.

nodes.title: Terminal Knowledge and Scripting
nodes.description: Bash or PowerShell, text manipulation, pipelines, grep/sed/awk, process monitoring, and basic automation.

nodes.title: Git and Version Control
nodes.description: Commits, branching, merging, rebasing, pull requests, conflict resolution, and collaboration workflows.

nodes.title: Programming for DevOps
nodes.description: Learn Python, Go, or JavaScript for automation, APIs, tooling, scripts, and systems glue code.

nodes.title: Web Servers and Reverse Proxies
nodes.description: Nginx, Caddy, Apache, IIS, Tomcat, forward/reverse proxying, load balancing, and runtime basics.

nodes.title: Foundations Quiz
nodes.description: Scored validation of Linux, networking, shell, and Git essentials.

nodes.title: Foundations Review
nodes.description: Recap weak areas in Linux, networking, shell, and Git before platform work.

nodes.title: Foundations Checkpoint
nodes.description: Readiness gate before containers, cloud, and delivery automation.

nodes.title: Foundations Milestone
nodes.description: Branch merge confirming baseline DevOps readiness.

nodes.title: Docker
nodes.description: Images, containers, volumes, networks, registries, Dockerfiles, and container lifecycle management.

nodes.title: Docker Practice Lab
nodes.description: Containerize an app, build images, attach volumes and networks, publish artifacts, and debug broken builds.

nodes.title: LXC and Container Alternatives
nodes.description: Optional exposure to non-Docker container approaches and runtime differences.

nodes.title: Kubernetes
nodes.description: Pods, deployments, services, ingress, config maps, scheduling, cluster architecture, and workload orchestration.

nodes.title: Kubernetes Practice Lab
nodes.description: Deploy workloads, expose services, configure ingress, mount configs, and debug failed pods.

nodes.title: Managed Kubernetes (GKE / EKS / AKS)
nodes.description: Use cloud-managed Kubernetes platforms and understand control plane tradeoffs.

nodes.title: Containers and Orchestration Checkpoint
nodes.description: Validation gate for production-ready container and cluster fundamentals.

nodes.title: Cloud Providers
nodes.description: Core concepts across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud: compute, storage, networking, IAM, and managed services.

nodes.title: CI/CD Fundamentals
nodes.description: Build, test, artifact, deployment stages, environment promotion, and delivery patterns.

nodes.title: GitHub Actions Pipeline Practice
nodes.description: Implement CI/CD with GitHub Actions for build, test, lint, artifact, and deployment automation.

nodes.title: CI/CD Alternatives (Jenkins / GitLab CI / CircleCI / TeamCity / Octopus)
nodes.description: Alternative tooling choices to the recommended CI/CD path.

nodes.title: Provisioning with Terraform
nodes.description: Provision infrastructure with modules, providers, variables, remote state, and plan/apply workflows.

nodes.title: Provisioning Alternatives (CloudFormation / Pulumi / CDK)
nodes.description: Alternative provisioning frameworks for cloud infrastructure automation.

nodes.title: Configuration Management (Ansible Recommended)
nodes.description: Automate machine setup, packages, files, users, and services with declarative configuration workflows.

nodes.title: Secrets Management
nodes.description: Vault, External Secrets Operator, sealed secrets, SOPs, and cloud-native secret handling.

nodes.title: GitOps (ArgoCD Recommended, FluxCD Alternative)
nodes.description: Declarative deployment, reconciliation loops, drift control, and Git as the source of truth.

nodes.title: Delivery and Automation Quiz
nodes.description: Scored validation of CI/CD, provisioning, configuration automation, GitOps, and secrets management.

nodes.title: Delivery Milestone
nodes.description: Merge point confirming readiness to manage and operate production systems.

nodes.title: Production Readiness Gate
nodes.description: Explicit gate requiring operational evidence before advanced observability and reliability work.

nodes.title: Infrastructure Monitoring (Prometheus and Grafana)
nodes.description: Metrics, dashboards, alerting, scrape models, SLO views, and operational visibility.

nodes.title: Logs Management
nodes.description: Centralized logging with ELK, Loki, Graylog, Splunk, and log pipeline fundamentals.

nodes.title: Tracing and OpenTelemetry
nodes.description: Distributed tracing with Jaeger and OpenTelemetry for request flow and latency analysis.

nodes.title: Observability Practice Lab
nodes.description: Build dashboards, alerts, logs, and troubleshooting playbooks for a sample platform.

nodes.title: Operations KSA Assessment Hook
nodes.description: Pointer node for mini-assessment preparation around troubleshooting and operational reasoning.

nodes.title: Operations Checkpoint
nodes.description: Validation gate for production troubleshooting, monitoring, and observability maturity.

nodes.title: Service Mesh
nodes.description: Istio, Linkerd, Envoy, and Consul for service-to-service traffic policy, observability, and security.

nodes.title: Serverless
nodes.description: AWS Lambda, Cloudflare, Azure Functions, Netlify, and event-driven platform tradeoffs.

nodes.title: Cloud Design Patterns
nodes.description: Availability, resilience, data management, implementation, and management/monitoring design patterns.

nodes.title: DevOps Review and Readiness
nodes.description: Recap and remediate weak areas across delivery, cloud, operations, and architecture before the capstone.

nodes.title: DevOps Capstone
nodes.description: Integrate Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, IaC, observability, secrets, and cloud architecture in a production-style system.
